text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heh, reminds me of school field trips when I was a kid!
Come on, step on it!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Let's hurry up and get there! To the zoo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a day off, I happened to get my hands on some zoo tickets.
When I showed them to Jungle Pocket, we ended up visiting together.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Look at that huge yawn!
This guy's totally slackin' off! Is he really supposed to be a lion?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, love 'em! Somethin' about 'em is super chill.
Just watchin' these animals laze around, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hm? ...Oho?
Hey, Trainer! Stand right there for a sec!

text_block_list.name: Bengal Tiger
text_block_list.text: ROAAARRRRRR!!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! What's with that cute squeak?!
Turns out that spot's the "Extreme Tiger Thrill Zone!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Did I scare ya? My bad, my bad!
My turn next! Swap with me!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...I'll mess you up, punk.
Come on, repeat after me!

text_block_list.name: Parrot
text_block_list.text:
MESS YOU UP, PUNK!
MESS YOU UP, PUNK!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! That's awesome! Smart bird, smart bird!
Now if you just put a little more menace into it, you'll sound real legit!
choice_data_list: What on earth are you teaching that parrot...?
What on earth are you teaching that parrot...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a hippo. Hippos are pretty cool too.
Though personally, I like lions better.

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text:
...Nuh-uh, Mr. Hippo is way stronger than Mr. Lion!
If he gets serious, Mr. Hippo is the strongest of all!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...What're you sayin', kiddo? Ain't no way a lion loses to a hippo!
One bite with those fangs and it's game over!

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text:
Hippos have super thick skin, so fangs can't even hurt them!
And get this! Their bite force is over 1,700 pounds!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Wh— Are you serious?! That's insane!
Hippos don't mess around...! Hey, tell me more!
Now I'm really curious!

text_block_list.name: Boy's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry for him suddenly bothering you...
I hope he isn't being a nuisance?
choice_data_list: Not at all, she seems to be having a great time too.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! The kid says he wants to walk
around the zoo with us! We can, right?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Sweet! Alright, where to next?
Let's go find an animal even stronger than a hippo!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, not bad, kid! You really know your stuff
when it comes to animals! You're like a professor!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Man, all that walking made me parched.
Wanna take a breather?

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text:
...Oh! I want ice cream then!
Mommy, ice cream! The strawberry one!

text_block_list.name: Boy's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, honestly, what am I going to do with you...
I'll go buy some, so could you watch him for a moment?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ice cream? ...Wait, that sounds so good.
Hey, Trainer, I want some too. Come on, please?
choice_data_list: ...I'll go get it. Keep an eye on the kid, okay?
...I'll go get it. Keep an eye on him, okay?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heh! Thanks!
Get me chocolate! The biggest scoop they got!

text_block_list.name: Vendor
text_block_list.text:
One chocolate and one strawberry, coming right up!
—And with that, we're all sold out of strawberry!

text_block_list.name: Rough-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? What? No more strawberry ice cream?
Chi-chan said she wanted strawberry, though?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While I was ordering the ice cream, an aggressive-looking
man suddenly cut right in front of us...!

text_block_list.name: Rough-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's your problem?
You got something to say to me, pal?!

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text:
......
Mommy's taking a long time...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Did they get lost or something?
Guess we gotta go check on 'em.

text_block_list.name: Rough-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
Like I said! I need to bring strawberry ice cream back
for Chi-chan! You hear me?! I'm screwed if you take it!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Tch. Guess I gotta teach this guy a lesson.
choice_data_list: N-No! That's not how this works!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Swallowing my fear, I stand my ground with as much
resolve as I can muster. I can't let him push us around...!
choice_data_list: Y-You need to wait in line! Like everyone else!

text_block_list.name: Rough-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
Oh-ho. Got some nerve on you, pretty boy.
What was that? Say it again to my face!

text_block_list.name: Rough-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
Oh-ho. Got some nerve on you, lady.
What was that? Say it again to my face!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm terrified, but... if I want to be worthy
of standing beside her as her partner...!

text_block_list.name: Little Boy
text_block_list.text:
P-Pokke-oneechan...?
Are you not gonna go help?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Nah.
They got this. No need to worry.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: This fight's already won.

text_block_list.name: Rough-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
...Tch, whatever, forget it then!
Chi-chaaan, they're all sold ooout!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, look at you, Trainer.
Tryna act all cool on your own, huh?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Sure was. ...Heh.
Not bad at all, partner.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Must've been scary as hell, though, right? You could've just
called for me, ya know. No need to act all stubborn.
choice_data_list: As your partner, I wanted to do my best in my own way.
As your partner, I wanted to do my best in my own way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm still not reliable enough to be Jungle Pocket's partner.
That's exactly why I didn't want to run away in a moment like this.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I get it... Yeah, I hear ya!
Man, that's pretty badass. *poke poke*

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, let's eat some ice cream! Ice cream!
You got it, right? The chocolate one.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You fought hard back there, so I'll share some of mine with ya!
Come on, let's eat together!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Man, what a day!!
We're definitely going again! Let's bring those kids next time too!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heh! Later, partner.
Stay warm and get some sleep.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: “Get! In! Line! Please!!”

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Stepping up when it counts, huh?
—Guess I already knew that, though.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: They're pretty great after all.
